wholePhysicalScope: Two named OSM outlines bind the courtyard arcade and main mosque. The two southern minaret centers are mapped and the other two are allocated to the documented outer corners.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the broad prayer hall, open courtyard and four separately articulated minarets.
limitations: The rectangular bodies follow the map and the comparative architectural survey. Roof and masonry details, the placement of the two northern minarets, their secondary heights and the ornament are approximate.
The separate madrasa buildings, graveyard, interior and calligraphy are outside scope. The fountain canopy and entrance steps are simplified.
Original open regional elevation is preserved. Paving and street geometry around the historic exterior are approximate.
